title: Documentary voice-over
intro: Local subtitle review, Google Gemini speech, start-only timing and an additional audio track. Original video, audio and subtitles are copied, never intentionally re-encoded or replaced.
openFirst: Open a video or project first.
replaceSubtitles: Replace the current grouping and edits with another subtitle file? The original files will not be changed.
subtitleHint: External text files must be UTF-8. Bitmap PGS/VobSub tracks require external text subtitles. ffprobe must be installed locally.
regroupConfirm: Rebuild the grouping from the original subtitles? Current edits can still be restored with Undo.
previewHint: Click a cue to seek. Video preview codec support depends on the platform; this does not change the lossless export path.
endSeconds: Original end (seconds; not a TTS deadline)
splitHint: Place the cursor between words. The suggested time is proportional, not speech-aligned; check it against the video before splitting.
approve: I have reviewed the grouping, text and start times
apiKey: Google Gemini API key (session only; or GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable)
privacy: Only segment text and style go to Google's Gemini API. Video and original audio remain local. Keys are kept in main-process memory, not in project JSON. Synthesis and regeneration may incur API charges.
speedHint: One fixed speed is applied locally to all clips. Changing it reuses cached Google audio. Starts stay fixed; subtitle ends never stretch, truncate or shift speech.
mixHint: All original channels, including LFE, follow the same timeline envelope. In 5.1, narration goes only to front center; in stereo it is centered. The original audio track is also retained unchanged.
sampleHint: Samples use stream copy too, so they can start at an earlier keyframe and last slightly longer. Boundary context may synthesize up to 120 seconds / speed of preceding speech; successful clips are cached for the full render. Choose an unused MKV filename.
tailWarning: Narration extends beyond the video; speech is preserved, not truncated. Extra seconds
overlapWarning: Overlapping narration (not automatically moved or compressed). Click to review:

stage.mux: Copying original streams and adding the new track
